title: Incursions in the city of Nauta
summary: Tim Alberino tells of Incursions in the city of Nauta, about c. 2023 at Nauta, Peru, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: in the jungle. They also happened in the city of Na.

plain: A researcher and filmmaker named Tim Alberino says that around 2023, strange beings made incursions, that is, appeared and attacked or intruded, among people in the Peruvian Amazon. According to Alberino, these events happened not only out in the jungle but also in the town of Nauta, which would mean the encounters reached a populated place and not just remote villages.
